name: Show Seconds in Clock
description: Adds seconds to the taskbar clock.
author: AETHER

compatibility.notes: Supported on Windows 10 and on Windows 11 22621.1992 or newer. Windows 11 builds 22000–22621.1991 ignore this setting.

settings.label: Restart Explorer to apply immediately
settings.description: Windows 10 and some Windows 11 builds only read this value when Explorer starts.

documentation.uninstall: The value is restored (or removed if it did not exist).
